candidates: When code in one package needs to call a function exported by another package in the monorepo, import via the public package export (e.g., `import fn from '@storybook/addon-vitest/postinstall'`) rather than a deep relative path into the other package's source directory (e.g., `../../../../addons/vitest/src/postinstall`). Deep relative paths are fragile under directory restructuring and bypass the package's intended API surface.

When loading template files as plain text at Node.js runtime (outside the esbuild pipeline), use `fs.readFile()` with a `new URL(relativePath, import.meta.url)` locator rather than dynamic `import()`. Node.js cannot handle non-JS file extensions (`.txt`, `.ts` templates, etc.) via `import()` and throws `ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION`.

In Vitest test files, mock modules using `vi.mock('module', { spy: true })` at the top level, then configure mock behavior inside `beforeEach` with `vi.mocked(fn).mockImplementation(...)`. Avoid inline factory functions that re-implement module behavior; this violates the project's spy-mocking convention (see `.cursor/rules/spy-mocking.mdc`).

`forEach` callbacks must not return a value. When the callback body is an assignment expression (e.g., `([key, value]) => (obj = obj.replace(key, value))`), convert it to a block-body arrow function or a `for...of` loop to satisfy the Biome `lint/suspicious/useIterableCallbackReturn` rule enforced in this codebase.

When adding a new option or behavioral flag to one package manager proxy (e.g., `PNPMProxy.runPackageCommand`), apply the equivalent change to all other proxy implementations (`NPMProxy`, `Yarn1Proxy`, `Yarn2Proxy`, `BunProxy`) so the `JsPackageManager` abstraction remains consistent across package managers.

When filtering entries from a `Map` where `null` encodes success and a non-null value (e.g., an `Error`) encodes failure, use a truthiness or strict-null check (e.g., `map.get(key) !== null`) rather than property access on the stored value (e.g., `map.get(key)?.result === 'failed'`), which will always evaluate to `undefined`.

When a function or module uses an unusual implementation pattern forced by a tooling constraint (e.g., enumerating template imports individually in a `switch/case` because esbuild does not support glob imports combined with the `?raw` query), add a JSDoc or inline comment at the definition site explaining why the simpler, more natural approach does not work.
